# InferenceX single-turn (metricscore)

!!! info "BLIS binaries these results describe"
    - `(devel)+9e3c509c8788fe0743605a8f06e0bf5c1c39ac1f`, binary sha256 `29fb09054a10ee51dc104f491cb09337e0ba527055b85653d281f23230451dff`

`tools/metricscore` scores BLIS against InferenceX's single-turn sweeps (random fixed ISL/OSL, closed loop at concurrency `CONC`, `10*CONC` requests) from the [InferenceX](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX) database dump of 2026-09-28. It replays the exact seed-0 length vectors the client drew; see [The published accuracy figures](../guide/latency-models.md#the-published-accuracy-figures) for the method.

Signed error `100 * (BLIS / measured - 1)`: positive means BLIS predicts higher latency (pessimistic).

## Provenance verdict

| verdict | sweeps | model families |
|---|---|---|
| EXACT | 0 | -- |
| PARTIAL | 68 | deepseek-v4, gpt-oss, kimi, minimax |
| NOT_REPRODUCIBLE | 45 | llama |

**No sweep is EXACT.** Every PARTIAL sweep left at least one engine setting unpassed, so the harness used the value vLLM resolves for it (tier MEASURED-OR-RESOLVED). Unpassed settings, by number of PARTIAL sweeps:

| setting | sweeps |
|---|---|
| `block_size` | 48 |
| `enable_prefix_caching` | 1 |
| `max_num_batched_tokens` | 11 |
| `max_num_seqs` | 31 |

NOT_REPRODUCIBLE sweeps have no engine-args log, so the settings they passed are unknown, and their sent prompt lengths are not verified equal to the replayed targets. They enter only the ALL (approximate) tier below, and no conclusion. The workload is single-turn random ISL/OSL, not agentic.

**What would make a sweep EXACT** (tier STRICT): an engine-args log at every concurrency, every admission setting passed by the run rather than left to vLLM's default, and the sent prompt lengths verified.
